question.text: Which of the following graph correctly represents the plots of \(\mathrm{K}_{\mathrm{H}}\) at 1 bar gases in water versus temperature?

solution.text: As temperature increases solubility first decrease then increase hence \(\mathrm{K}_{\mathrm{H}}\) first increase than decrease also at moderate temperature \(\mathrm{K}_{\mathrm{H}}\) value \(\mathrm{He}  \gt  \mathrm{N}_2  \gt  \mathrm{CH}_4\).
